# Steamy34

> Steamy34 is a free userscript for rule34.xxx by steamycorner. It adds White / Dark / OLED colour modes, a popup viewer, an easier tag search with filters, downloads named after the post's tags ([character] [series] [artist] #post.jpg, key B), batch downloads, following artists and tag searches with new-post counts, local collections and a touch-friendly Android layout. It runs in Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey. Free, never monetized, collects no data, not affiliated with rule34.xxx. License: CC0 1.0.
